description: ICT Testing Baseline v3.1 Conformance Audit Report format specification

findings.element_id: string - id attribute of the element, or 'html' for language check, 'title' for title check
findings.baseline_test_id: string - ICT Baseline Test ID from the set: '6.A', '6.B', '10.A', '11.A', '12.A', '12.B', '13.A', '15.A'
findings.result: string - 'FAIL' only (passing elements are omitted from findings)
findings.wcag_sc: string - primary WCAG 2.x Success Criterion in dotted notation, e.g. '1.1.1', '4.1.2', '2.4.2'
findings.description: string - human-readable description of the finding

6.A.name: MeaningfulImage
6.A.description: Images with non-empty text alternative: verify role is not presentational, text alternative is equivalent

6.B.name: DecorativeImage
6.B.description: Images with empty text alternative: verify proper decorative technique, not focusable, no role conflicts

10.A.name: FormName
10.A.description: Form controls: accessible name must be non-empty and computed correctly

11.A.name: PageTitled
11.A.description: Page must have a non-empty title element

12.A.name: DataTableRole
12.A.description: Data tables must have correct programmatic roles for table, rows, headers, and cells

12.B.name: DataTableHeaderAssociation
12.B.description: Data cells must be programmatically associated with their headers via scope or headers/id

13.A.name: HeadingDescriptive
13.A.description: Programmatic headings must describe the topic or purpose of their content

15.A.name: LanguageOfPage
15.A.description: The html element must have a valid lang attribute identifying the primary language
